items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: Come on, Norris. They took a month and take a year off.

ctx.x: Had the Crescent Stars. And had the Dr. Ray. It's a giant target. And I should be in the Rock Island. I'm not some great golfers. Come on, Norris. They took a month and take a year off.
You ever see the Homestead Grays? Homestead Grays. Yes, I want to. I want to. I want to. Did you have any special favorite team? Yes.
